name: All three locale translation files exist and are non-empty
description: Translations are backed by /public/locales/en.json, es.json and pt.json. Each must exist and contain a non-trivial set of key/value pairs. A missing es.json or pt.json (or an empty {} stub) means translations are not actually shipped.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /locales/en.json and read the JSON body
Navigate to /locales/es.json and read the JSON body
Navigate to /locales/pt.json and read the JSON body

Verify all three locale files return 200 with a parseable JSON object containing multiple translation keys (not empty, not a single placeholder). If any file 404s or is an empty object, the test fails.
